T: Juuust a bit outside the menu.
D: A ragtag Cleveland baseball team sets out to win the pennant after the owner tries to tank the season.
P: Serve the drink for Jobu when Cerrano steps up to bat.
S: Potato and cheese pierogi boiled then pan-fried in butter until crisp, piled with golden caramelised onions, sour cream and chives. Slowly fry 2 sliced onions in 30g butter over low heat for 20 minutes until deep golden. Boil 24 frozen potato and cheese pierogi for 4 minutes until they float, then drain well. Heat 40g butter in a large frying pan and fry the pierogi for 2 to 3 minutes a side until crisp and golden. Pile onto a platter, top with the onions and serve with 200g sour cream and snipped chives.

Raw peanuts roasted with honey, butter, brown sugar and a kick of chilli and sea salt, cooled into crunchy, sticky clusters. Melt 30g butter with 3 tbsp honey and 1 tbsp brown sugar. Toss 400g raw unsalted peanuts in the mix with 1/2 tsp chilli flakes until coated. Spread on a lined tray and bake at 170C for 15 to 18 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until deep golden. Sprinkle with 1 tsp sea salt flakes and 1 tbsp caster sugar while hot. Cool completely and break into clusters.
M: Cleveland Polish boy with fries and slaw

Cleveland's ballpark favourite: grilled kielbasa in a soft roll piled with hot chips, smoky barbecue sauce and tangy coleslaw. Bake 800g frozen chips at 220C for 25 minutes. Toss half a shredded cabbage and 1 grated carrot with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp cider vinegar and 1 tsp sugar. Score 4 kielbasa sausages and grill for 8 minutes, turning, until charred. Split 4 long soft rolls. Lay a kielbasa in each, pile on a handful of hot chips, drizzle generously with 150ml smoky barbecue sauce and top with the slaw.
W: A deep cherry pie with a golden sugared lattice top, the filling sweet, sharp and bubbling, served warm with vanilla ice cream. Drain 2 x 680g jars pitted cherries, keeping 150ml juice. Simmer the juice with 100g caster sugar and 2 tbsp cornflour until thick, then stir in the cherries and a squeeze of lemon. Line a 23cm pie dish with 1 sheet shortcrust pastry and fill. Cut 2 sheets into strips and weave a lattice over the top. Brush with 1 beaten egg, sprinkle with 1 tbsp sugar and bake at 190C for 40 minutes. Rest 20 minutes and serve with ice cream.
K: Jobu's dark rum and ginger punch

Dark rum, ginger beer, fresh lime and a dash of bitters over ice, with a little shot poured for Jobu first. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Add 45ml dark rum and the juice of half a lime to each glass. Top each with 150ml cold ginger beer and add 2 dashes of aromatic bitters. Stir once and garnish with a lime wedge. Pour one extra small shot of rum into a glass and set it aside for Jobu before anyone takes a sip.
